scope: Read-only input fingerprint comparison; no tests rerun. Final entry and browser inputs are checked individually. Early failures remain failures. Reconstruction uses each report baseCommit plus its byte-exact source-delta.

Source is reconstructible from baseCommit plus the retained source-delta, with every input SHA recorded.
